'''35''' was a rookie [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in [[Excelsior Company]] under the command of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vargus]].

==Biography==
{{RPG|''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''}}
35 was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] that served in [[Excelsior Company]]. He was one of six [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to be selected for [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Vargus]]'s special mission to [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The mission was to find the whereabouts of the [[313th Legion]], which had gone missing during a routine attack on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] base there. While traveling to the base, 35 and several other clones asked the sergeant, [[Ace (clone trooper)|18]], if they could use the [[Podracing/Legends|podracers]] to get there faster, as they had discovered several abandoned Pods in a canyon. However, 18 turned down their request due to the danger of a Human trying to drive a Pod. Upon entering the base, they found a [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] engineer who was employed by the Separatist to create a [[hyperspace warping device]], which [[General/Legends|General]] [[Terrus]] planned to use for a surprise attack on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When learning that the scientist, [[Vylagos]], would die if his helmet was removed, Vargus struck a deal with him, the terms being that if Vylagos could bring the 313th Legion back, Vargus would not take off the Skakoan's helmet.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />

Vylagos then calibrated the device to transport all living things within one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] of the device to be transported back to Ando Prime. While he was calibrating it, they met Clone Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who were also looking for the legion. 35 went through with [[Falco]], [[Dom]], [[16]], [[44]], [[57]], Cody, Kenobi, and 18. They were transported to a rocky, barren world that was, according to Vylagos, in the far reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. 18 told Jedi General [[Po Bandis]] to gather all the troops into a one-kilometer radius, then the general sent them to destroy a [[Confederacy listening post]], located nearby. The clones hijacked a modified [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|hailfire droid]], which was now a manned tank, and used its missiles to destroy the listening post. When they drove back, with Dom tossing out [[pulse grenade]]s the whole way, the legion was gathered in the one-kilometer radius, so they were transported back.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
35 first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]'', which has approximately thirty-five different endings, branching out from four different beginnings. 35 appears if the reader chooses 18 to become a sergeant, and depending on some of the reader's choices, 35 may not even appear. 35 is erroneously referred to as "15" at one point in the book.<ref name="The Lost Legion" />
